# Bundled look-alike fonts

Used when a PDF's original font is not installed and its embedded copy is missing letters.
Each is metric-compatible with a common commercial font, so edited lines keep their length.

| File prefix | Stands in for | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| arimo   | Arial, Helvetica        | Apache License 2.0 |
| tinos   | Times New Roman, Times  | Apache License 2.0 |
| cousine | Courier New, Courier    | Apache License 2.0 |
| carlito | Calibri                 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| caladea | Cambria                 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

Source: Google Fonts (fonts.google.com). Arimo/Tinos/Cousine are the designs that
Liberation Sans/Serif/Mono 2.x are built from.
